text: 周一国际原油低开，布油一度跌逾7%，跌破90美元，纳指期货涨超1%。 美伊暂停互袭：伊朗军方周日称美方连续两晚停袭、伊方暂停对等打击。红海局势升温：也门胡塞武装周六一天内两次袭击沙特红海港口石油设施，沙特空袭回应。 中国证监会原副主席方星海被查。 王毅会见伊朗外长阿拉格齐，称中方继续支持巴基斯坦等各方斡旋努力，尽早恢复当事方对话谈判，妥处霍尔木兹海峡问题。 中国商务部：将14家欧盟实体列入出口管制管控名单。 财政部、税务总局：居民个人装入离岸信托的财产及信托存续收益，均须依法缴纳个人所得税。 “两高”修改司法解释，加大力度惩治内幕交易、泄露内幕信息犯罪。
text_en: International crude opened lower Monday, with Brent falling over 7% at one point, breaking below $90, while Nasdaq futures rose over 1%. US-Iran mutual strikes paused: Iran's military said Sunday the US halted strikes for two consecutive nights, and Iran suspended retaliatory strikes. Red Sea tensions heat up: Yemen's Houthis attacked Saudi Red Sea port oil facilities twice in one day Saturday, with Saudi airstrikes in response. Former CSRC Vice Chairman Fang Xinghai is under investigation. Wang Yi met Iran's Foreign Minister Araghchi, saying China continues to support mediation efforts by Pakistan and others, urging early resumption of dialogue and proper handling of the Hormuz Strait issue. China's MOFCOM placed 14 EU entities on an export control list. MOF and STA: individual property placed in offshore trusts and trust income during the period must pay individual income tax. The 'Two Supremes' revised judicial interpretations to intensify punishment for insider trading and leaking inside information.
